run_render_asset_cli: run the render_asset CLI to render a volumetric primitives asset with Mitsuba
test_volprim_io_asset_to_dict: test the volprim.io.asset_to_dict function that converts a Python asset file to a scene dictionary
test_volprim_io_scale_films: test the volprim.io.scale_films function that scales camera film resolution by a given factor
run_mitsuba_render_pipeline: run the mitsuba render pipeline using mi.load_dict, mi.render, and mi.util.write_bitmap
run_volprim_benchmark_single_run: run the volprim.benchmark.single_run context manager to benchmark rendering performance
